verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical. In both, the photo is cropped so far into the fig that the cake and the actual dish are gone, leaving a blurry abstract strip. The 'Perfect Taste' wreath is shrunk to a small mid-canvas emblem, too small for its script text to read well at banner size, and it sits on a busy, low-contrast part of the photo. Most of the left side is dead blur, so the layout doesn't read left to right.
